title: Ink Flow
description: Ink sheets unfold into fine currents and diluted washes. Music carries the flow onward; hand sweeps gather and draw out the pigment.

parameters.label: Ink Spread
parameters.description: Coverage of the dense ink pools.

parameters.label: Eddy
parameters.description: Strength of the layered rolling currents.

parameters.label: Ink Veins
parameters.description: Density of the fine strands following the ink currents.

parameters.label: Capillary Detail
parameters.description: Weight of the fine ink threads around the pool edges.

parameters.label: Flow
parameters.description: Continuous movement of the ink streams.

parameters.label: Ink Impulse
parameters.description: Musical impulses advance pigment along the flow.

parameters.label: Hand Pull
parameters.description: Strength of the local brush pulling the ink in the direction of hand movement.

parameters.label: Brush X
parameters.description: Horizontal brush position, driven by Source B.

parameters.label: Brush Y
parameters.description: Vertical brush position, driven by Source B.

parameters.label: Trail X
parameters.description: Horizontal trailing end of the brush stroke.

parameters.label: Trail Y
parameters.description: Vertical trailing end of the brush stroke.

parameters.label: Trail Fade
parameters.description: The trailing influence fades after the hand leaves.

parameters.label: Hand Motion
parameters.description: Movement of the Source B hand; a still hand applies no force.

provenance.prompt_summary: Approved Ink Flow: overlapping ink currents unfold and disperse; beat and Source B hand sweeps advance the flow with retained momentum.
